::: {.cv-section}
## Selected Projects & Research

::: {.cv-entry}
<span class="cv-left"><a href="projects/medicaid-expansion.html">Medicaid Expansion &amp; Health Insurance Coverage</a></span>
:::
::: {.cv-detail}
Staggered difference-in-differences (Callaway-Sant'Anna estimator) analysis of ACA Medicaid expansion using ACS (2010-2019) and BRFSS (2011-2019) panel data. Found a 2.3 percentage point reduction in the uninsured rate among non-elderly adults (95% CI: −3.5 to −1.1 pp), with a 5.1 pp reduction among adults below 200% FPL. Includes an accompanying policy brief written for state-level decision-makers.
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
<span class="cv-left"><a href="projects/ada-parc.html">ADA-PARC Project</a></span>
:::
::: {.cv-detail}
Descriptive and index-based analysis of quality-of-life disparities between disabled and non-disabled populations using 2023 ACS 5-year data across all 50 states and hundreds of geographies. Delivered via written report, an R Shiny application, and scorecard dashboards built natively in R and Quarto.
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
<span class="cv-left"><a href="projects/wic.html">WIC Program Evaluation</a></span>
:::
::: {.cv-detail}
Regression discontinuity design estimating the effect of WIC income-eligibility (185% FPL) on infant birth weight, using synthetic data to demonstrate the evaluation framework under realistic data constraints. With Emily Frost and Samantha Sepulveda, UIC PA 528.
:::
:::
